page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Left margin holds only the printed quotation marks (») beside the lines of the quoted passage. No other notes, no footnotes. Running head at the top, page number at the top left.

main_text.p: cōstituta ciuitas fuisset. Hinc Iurisconsultos iusticię sacerdotes appellari uidemus: quippe qui Iusticiæ deæ oracula & responsa consulentibus enūcient. sic enim sensisse Vl-pianum, mihi quidem dubiū uideri nō potest: tametsi longè aliter uerba ipsius ab eru-ditis. quibusque uulgò intelligantur. sic autem & legendum & interpungendū eum esse locum existimo: Ius est à iusticia appellatum (nam ut eleganter Celsus definit, Ius est ars æqui & boni) cuius merito nos quis Sacerdotes appellet. Vt uox CVIVS, nō ad IVS, sed ad Iusticiæ deę nomen

page.notes: The left margin has » marks beside the lines from "esse locum existimo" to "appellet". These are printed quotation marks, not text, so they are not transcribed as notes. The running head's decorated title is illegible. The page number is printed as a superscript "3º" (30). "Vl-" and "eru-" keep their printed hyphens at line ends. Long s is transcribed as s throughout, and u/v and i/j are normalised.
